decisions.reason: The delayed US release and narrow particle therapy market suggest its option value is unlikely to justify continued investment.
Small volume ionization chambers have growing use in stereotactic and small-field dosimetry, and keeping costs are relatively low.

Standard clinical chambers are core to the firm's QA portfolio and have established demand.
Relative dosimetry chambers are standard tools that complement the firm's integrated QA offering.
